==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I am in a Pixie Dust Bath Shop. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (A Pixie Dust Bath Shop is a store full of pools of different types of pixie dust. Each type has a different color and a different magical effect.)
Were-Cat thieves burst in to steal the dust. (The Were-Cat thieves resembled humanoid cats wearing black bandanas over their face and horizontally striped white and black shirts, black pants, and black boots.)
A worker at the store defeated the thieves with a burning pixie dust that turned the thieves into good elves. (The Pixie Dust Bath Shop worker resembled an orange skinned, blonde, pixie woman. She wore her hair as a ponytail. She wore an emerald green golf shirt, gray pants, and black boots. She had an hourglass figure.) (The Burning Pixie Dust effectively burns away the evil in someone and reverts them to their base form.)
